title: Spatially deterministic nucleation of 2D semiconductors by etching flux
title_zh: 通过蚀刻流实现二维半导体的空间确定性成核
abstract: Abstract Nucleation control is fundamental to semiconductor deposition, governing when, where and how crystalline materials form. Conventional strategies can regulate nucleation density and, through area-selective growth, confine deposition to designated regions 1–13 . However, they generally do not determine where an individual nucleus forms within the growth regions, leaving even single-nucleation events spatially stochastic and limiting deterministic construction of crystalline materials. Here we report etching-flux-mediated single-centred nucleation of two-dimensional (2D) semiconductors to deterministically localize a single nucleation event. The etching flux released from the barrier suppresses nuclei near the pattern boundary, leaving a single surviving nucleus at the pattern centre, and systematic experiments elucidate the mechanism and establish nucleation design rules for zero, single and multiple nucleation regimes. Etching-flux-mediated single-centred nucleation enables single-crystal molybdenum disulfide growth at the 10-μm scale, field-effect mobilities of up to 117 cm 2 V −1 s −1 and large-area uniformity with process compatibility. This in-plane chemical-flux strategy realizes spatially programmed growth, demonstrating nucleation–growth decoupling for line-shaped single crystals, multiple transistors integrated within a large common crystal, and aligned 2D lateral heterostructures for self-aligned contacts. These capabilities open a path towards advanced 2D electronic integration and expand semiconductor deposition from controlling where materials grow to controlling where and how crystals can begin to form.
abstract_zh: 摘要 成核控制是半导体沉积的基础，决定了晶体材料何时、何地以及如何形成。传统策略可以调节成核密度，并通过面积选择性生长将沉积限制在指定区域，但它们通常无法确定单个核在生长区内的具体位置，使得即使是单核成核事件也具有空间随机性，限制了晶体材料的确定性构建。本文报道了通过蚀刻流实现二维（2D）半导体单中心成核的方法，从而实现单个成核事件的确定性定位。障碍物释放的蚀刻流抑制了靠近图案边界的核，留下单个存活核在图案中心，系统实验阐明了机制并建立了零、单、复合成核模式的成核设计规则。蚀刻流介导的单中心成核实现了10 µm尺度单晶二硫化钼的生长，场效应迁移率高达117 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹，并兼容工艺的全尺寸均匀性。这种面内化学流策略实现了空间编程生长，展示了线形单晶的成核-生长解耦、在大晶体内集成多晶体管以及自对准接触的二维横向异质结构。这些能力为先进的二维电子集成开辟了道路，并将半导体沉积从控制材料生长位置扩展到控制晶体何时以及如何开始形成。
